registration: No structural schema validation at registration (intentional deferral — no JSON Schema library, B40 forbids dependency addition).
executionInput: InputValidator.Validate size-only; InvocationValidator validates invocation fields.
executionResult: ResultValidator.Validate enforces status default, empty-result translation, and output byte cap.
errorMapping: errors are mapped to capability.ErrorCodeInvalidInput / ErrorCodeInvalidResult / etc. via failWithAudit / ResultValidator.
secretLeakProtection: Sanitizer redacts registered sensitive keys in ToolError.Details and result structured/content.
